{{Quote|But then again, I've never seen anything a Wookiee couldn't build or fix, given enough grease and transmission wire.|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] comments on the abilities of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>}}
'''Transmission wire''' was a type of [[Wikipedia:Wire|wire]] used in the manufacture and upkeep of objects.

[[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] were described by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] to be able to construct and repair anything, provided they possessed enough [[Grease/Legends|grease]] and transmission wire.

*''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''
